name: Fairness
overview: Scripture calls believers to uphold fairness by judging others without partiality, neither favoring the poor nor the mighty, and by rejecting bribery that distorts righteous judgment. The Lord delights in just measures and honest dealings, as seen in the condemnation of false balances and the affirmation that all weights belong to Him. Righteousness and consistent fairness bring blessing and joy, while injustice leads to destruction, underscoring the importance of integrity in all judgments.
